purpose: Teach: 如何なる/原著/生い立ち/懇願/物言い/卵子/破局/公道

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、如何なる困難な事案でも、警察、解決を諦められませんね
lines.en: No matter how difficult the case, police don't give up on solving it, do they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Genuine admiration underneath — not flattery. Slight upward lilt on the final particle, inviting agreement. Calm and observant.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、参考図書の原著を、捜査官、読まれますね
lines.en: Police carefully read the original sources when researching, don't they?
lines.style: Steady, affirming tone. Slightly slower than conversational — acknowledging the weight of the work. Warm agreement, not defensive. Direct eye contact level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の生い立ちを、警察、丁寧に調べられますね
lines.en: In this case, police investigate a suspect's background very carefully, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful and steady. Soft emphasis on 'carefully' — respecting the methodical nature of the work. Genuine curiosity, not interrogation. Slightly warm undertone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ご家族の早期解決を懇願する声に応えられますね
lines.en: Police listen to the families' pleas for early resolution and do their best to answer them, don't they?
lines.style: Sincere, grounded. Slight warmth acknowledging the human cost. Calm delivery — not dramatic. The tone of someone who has seen how much these cases matter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、目撃者の物言いを、警察、慎重に聞かれますね
lines.en: Police listen very carefully to what witnesses have to say in cases like these, don't they?
lines.style: Steady, methodical tone. Respect for the detail work — not rushed. Quiet conviction about the importance of precision. Even, thoughtful cadence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不妊治療で扱う卵子の盗難事件も対応されますね
lines.en: Police also handle cases like egg theft in fertility clinics with the same care, don't they?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not dismissive. Acknowledging the seriousness of cases beyond the obvious. Same steady respect as before — breadth of jurisdiction, not diminishing tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、関係破局後の保護対応を、警察、慎重におこなわれますね
lines.en: Police handle protection and follow-up very carefully after relationships break down, don't they?
lines.style: Gentle but not soft. Recognizing the vulnerability involved. Steady, grounded — the tone of someone who understands stakes. Slight warmth, no performance.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、公道での違法走行も取り締まりされますね
lines.en: Police also crack down on illegal street racing, don't they?
lines.style: Firmer now — practical shift in topic. Direct, no hesitation. Still respectful, but acknowledging different work. Clearer attack on the first word. Slightly more confident.
